name: Collection grid — six pieces render with name, number, and image

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage / and scroll to the section with id 'collection'
The heading text 'Six pieces. No repeats.' is visible
Exactly 6 collection items are rendered, each with a visible product image, a name (e.g. 'Nilgiri Kurti'), and a two-digit number (01 through 06)
Click on the first collection item
The page navigates to or scrolls to the section with id 'inquire'
